about_the_game:
The next evolution of the skate.™ franchise is here! Discover your new favorite hangout early as a Founding Founder by gearing up with in-game content as you explore this online multiplayer world fueled by skateboarding, self expression and community.

Unlock before December 2nd to receive these in-game items:
-“The Founding Founder” Title*
-The Founding Founder Sticker*
-The Founding Founder Varsity Jacket*
-Premium skate.Pass Season 1: (Note: skate.Pass available to play at the start of Season 1 on Oct. 7, 2025)**

*Exclusive to Founder’s Deluxe Pack or Deluxe Upgrade; cosmetic not available after Dec. 2, 2025
**Season 1 Skate.Pass available in-game during Season 1 beginning October 7, 2025 through December 2, 2025 at 10:00 am Pacific Time. Skate.Pass content requires all game updates and gameplay to unlock. Exact dates may vary and are subject to change.

This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items.
Requires Skate (available separately) and all game updates.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Win 10 64 Bit, non-launch version
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600k or AMD Ryzen 3 3100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or Radeon RX 460 (4GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 25 GB available space

  • OS: Win 10 64 Bit, non-launch version
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 9700 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3060 (12GB) or Radeon RX 6600 XT (8GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
